title: Reduction commutes with completed pullback
statement:
Let $g:T'\to T$ be a morphism of schemes and use the Noetherian adic datum $A,I,P_n=A/I^n$, coefficient sheaves $A_W=\varprojlim_n(P_n)_W$ for $W=T,T'$, and reduction tower of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(T_{\Proet},A_T))$ be derived $I$-complete in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion], and put $K_n=K\otimes^L_{A_T}(P_n)_T$. Let $L=Lg^*_{\mathrm{comp}}K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(T'_{\Proet},A_{T'}))$ be the completed pullback of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], and write $g_n^*$ for finite-coefficient module pullback as there.

Then $L$ is derived $I$-complete, and for every $n\geq1$ the projection of its defining derived limit to $Lg_n^*K_n$ induces a functorial isomorphism in $D(\operatorname{Mod}(T'_{\Proet},(P_n)_{T'}))$,
$$\alpha_n:L\otimes^L_{A_{T'}}(P_n)_{T'}\xrightarrow{\sim}Lg_n^*K_n.$$
These isomorphisms commute with the quotient transition maps. For $b\geq a\geq1$ they also commute with normalization: extending $\alpha_b$ from $(P_b)_{T'}$ to $(P_a)_{T'}$ and then using the normalization of the pulled-back reduction tower gives $\alpha_a$ after the canonical scalar-extension associativity identification. For $c\geq b\geq a$ these normalizations satisfy the quotient cocycle, and for equal indices the unit identity. All tensor products in the display are over the indicated sheaves of rings; no identification with an ordinary module derived category is asserted.

proof.text: Put $N=Lg_R^*\operatorname{Res}K$, $N_n=N\otimes^L_RS_n$ and $\widehat N=R\lim N_n$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-pulled-reduction-strict-tower-comparison]: $\operatorname{Res}L=\widehat N$, with evaluation $p_n$, unit $\eta$ and $p_n\eta=u_n$. Its $\tau_n:N_n\simeq Lg_n^*K_n$ preserve transitions. The adic datum supplies the Noetherian, torsion and perfect-quotient hypotheses of [def-weil-pbc-complete-coefficient-datum] for $N$.

source.place: Paragraph 2: augmented strict reduction tower of ordinary pullback.

proof.text: The reflector [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-completion-reflector] and the unit-preserving quotient/Koszul comparison [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence] make $\widehat N$ complete. Flatness there permits [lem-weil-pbc-flat-scalar-koszul-tower-comparison]: the restricted Koszul unit of $L$ is invertible. Restriction leaves cohomology sheaves unchanged, so reflects isomorphisms. Thus $L$ satisfies [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion].

source.place: Paragraph 1: completeness via the restricted Koszul unit.

proof.text: Apply [lemma-weil-pbc-adic-completion-reduction] to $N$, obtaining invertible $\beta_n:\widehat N\otimes^L_RS_n\to N_n$, adjoint to $p_n$. The flatness and multiplication isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-completed-constant-sheaf-reduction] permit [lem-weil-pbc-flat-coefficient-reduction-adjunct]. Its adjunct equation identifies $\alpha_n$ with $\tau_n\beta_n$ under its source comparison $\kappa_n$. All maps are natural in $K$.

Let $r_n=\eta\otimes^L1$. Under the derived scalar adjunction of [def-weil-pbc-projection-formula-arrows], the adjuncts of $\beta_nr_n$ and $1_{N_n}$ are both $u_n=p_n\eta$. Hence $\beta_nr_n=1$ and $r_n=\beta_n^{-1}$.

Naturality gives $q^{\widehat N}_{b,a}r_b=r_aq^N_{b,a}$. Cancel the invertible $r$ to get $q^N_{b,a}\beta_b=\beta_aq^{\widehat N}_{b,a}$. The transition-compatible $\tau$ of [lem-weil-pbc-pulled-reduction-strict-tower-comparison] and $\kappa$ of [lem-weil-pbc-flat-coefficient-reduction-adjunct] (steps 1 and 3) turn this into the transition square for $\alpha$.

Naturality of [lem-sfb-successive-derived-quotient-normalization] gives $\theta^{\widehat N}_{b,a}(r_b\otimes^L1)=r_a\theta^N_{b,a}$. Invert $r$ to get $\theta^N_{b,a}(\beta_b\otimes^L1)=\beta_a\theta^{\widehat N}_{b,a}$. The comparison square, cocycle and unit in [lem-weil-pbc-pulled-reduction-normalization-comparison], and scalar-associativity compatibility in [lem-weil-pbc-flat-coefficient-reduction-adjunct], turn this into all the asserted normalization equations for $\alpha$.

source.place: Paragraph 1: normalization square, quotient cocycle and equal-index unit.

blueprint_sketch.proof:
Derived pullback commutes with derived tensor, so its defining tower is the
reduction tower of $Lg^*K$. Apply finite reduction of adic completion to
this object. Its level $n$ is
$Lg^*K\otimes^L_\Lambda P_n\simeq Lg^*(K\otimes^L_\Lambda P_n)=Lg^*K_n$.

proof.text:
Completeness follows from the reconstruction of
[def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion] applied to the tower defining
[def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Tensoring the defining derived
limit with $P_n$ and using the finite reduction of
[lem-weil-pbc-finite-reduction-reconstruction] gives the displayed
isomorphism, with the stated compatibilities inherited from the tower
structure.

Derived pullback commutes with derived tensor, so its defining tower is the

this object. Its level $n$ is
$Lg^*K\otimes^L_\Lambda P_n\simeq Lg^*(K\otimes^L_\Lambda P_n)=Lg^*K_n$.
